semiconductor_relevance: High - TELTEC is a leading distributor of wafer fab equipment and materials in Europe and Asia, serving the semiconductor industry.
summary: TELTEC, founded in 1983, is a prominent distributor of wafer fabrication equipment and materials, providing a comprehensive range of services including sales, applications, installations, and warranty support. With a strong presence across Europe and Asia, TELTEC partners with leading equipment and materials manufacturers to deliver reliable solutions to the semiconductor sector.
capabilities: Sales and distribution of wafer fab equipment

regional_presence.Europe: TELTEC operates 9 offices throughout Europe, providing local sales and service.
regional_presence.Asia: The company also has a presence in Asia, enhancing its distribution capabilities in the region.
